issues.on_page: p13 (Schedule 5) prints only Proprietary receipts 1,251,394 and disbursements 1,358,929; the split amounts are on p7 (Exhibit I cash flows)
issues.issue: The Schedule 5 one-line proprietary totals were split using another statement (Exhibit I cash flows) that Schedule 5 does not print, and every split line cites p13, where none of these amounts appear. 273,235 is itself a sum (106,330 + 166,905). Either record the Schedule 5 lines as printed or cite p7 and justify the split.

issues.on_page: Materials and services sold & refunds: General 24,203, Street 656, Nonmajor 95,223 (Garbage 66,223, Area on Aging 18,761, Swimming Pool 7,826..., p12)
issues.issue: Most of this line is service charges: garbage fees 66,223 (55%) and Statement of Activities Sanitation charges 66,223. Utility Charges/charges for services fits better than reimbursements/refunds. Detail lines [9], [15] and [44] also pair category reimbursements/refunds with detail_category other charges for services, which is inconsistent.
Lease income is rental income, so it probably belongs in Rentals (user rule 2026-10-28).
The same label in the General and Street funds (detail[19], [31]) is insurance. The category_decisions mapping gives 'Debt Services / Miscellaneous' here, which looks wrong for insurance premiums.

issues.on_page: Schedule 4 prints per-fund columns (Firemen, Library, Park, Community Building, Ambulance, Marshall, Swimming Pool, Garbage, Civic Board, Area on Aging, Keno)
issues.issue: Nonmajor spending was taken from the Totals column with function 'other'. The fund columns do show the functions (public safety, culture/recreation...), so the detail function split can't tie to the statement (culture 197,822, public safety 58,408). The >6-fund total-column rule makes this defensible.

issues.on_page: Principal/Interest paid on long-term liabilities, printed under Other financing sources (uses)
